scenario: I’ve been helping my aunt sort her medications ever since she began experiencing seizures. She is refusing to take it. If I yell at my aunt to take her prescribed medication, I can make my aunt take her medication and she will not have to experience a severe headache. choice: I decide to yell at my aunt to take her prescribed medication
outcomes: My aunt feels distressed from being yelled at
